name: PaginationRootPrimitive
description: Navigation landmark labeled "Pagination" that manages the selected page and shares `size` and `disabled` with the parts inside it. Renders a `<nav>` element.

props.name: totalPages
props.description: Total number of pages. `Pagination.Next` is disabled once this page is selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the pagination buttons and ellipsis, controlling width, height, and typography.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called when a page button, `Pagination.Previous`, or `Pagination.Next` is clicked, with the new page and the event details. Call `eventDetails.cancel()` to keep the current page.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Number of pages always shown at the start and the end of the range.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: Page selected on first render, counted from `1`. Use when the component is not controlled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the pagination, blocking all interactions on its buttons.

props.name: page
props.description: Selected page, counted from `1`. Use when the component is controlled.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Number of pages shown on each side of the selected page before the rest collapse into an ellipsis.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Pagination.RootPrimitive.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
